findings.reason: the plan needs a graph-wide pre-export check, or an explicitly broader population, and a normal-export control over an exhausted dropped-edge name; otherwise its central release guard misses the largest cited cohort.
findings.text: §37 says a dropped-edge live name will stop the release by extending `_has_producing_source`, but normal `run_export` calls `_fetch_export_population` first, whose query admits only `name_stage IN ['accepted', 'approved']` (`export.py:628-639`); §35 counts 240 of 264 sourceless live names as exhausted (`plan.html:237`), so those names never reach the predicate or its refusal, and `_classify_export_population` checks stage before the source predicate (`export.py:872-878`) even if a fixture injects one

findings.reason: the plan must specify a graph-aware audit reader and a transaction-time orphan authority refusal, with tests through those real callers, before it can claim the three paths share one decision.
findings.text: §37 says `run_audits` and §31's orphan lifecycle read the same `_has_producing_source` classification, but the predicate's only caller is export eligibility (`export.py:877`), `run_audits` is called on candidate dictionaries without successor or history flags in `workers.py:5165,6617`, and `supersede_exhausted_standard_name_orphans` selects and mutates names using its own source-only Cypher (`graph_ops.py:22634-22641,22778-22786`); neither has the required successor/history evidence or a call to the export predicate, so changing that predicate alone cannot make either promised protection run

findings.reason: a test that calls the graph-aware audit path with a dropped-edge fixture and fails when that report is suppressed would make this promised path measurable.
findings.text: §37 promises that `run_audits` reports the four-way classification, but its done-when exercises export and the orphan lifecycle only; it declares no audit caller test or negative control, so the entire audit promise can be omitted while every named test and the §38 gate measure pass

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — the cited export predicate, `run_audits`, orphan lifecycle, `sn-review-through-jev` §5 and its 62-of-104 evidence resolve, as does the changed document's WEST plan target; no extensionless href in the changed units is broken.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §37's `plan.html:245` done-when has red controls for export refusal and orphan exemption, but none for its promised `run_audits` classification.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §37 names `docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-source-audit-gate.html` at `plan.html:245`, a durable repository path for its gate record.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §37 names `_has_producing_source` and `run_audits` by mechanism and introduces no plan-labelled source symbol or changelog prose.
rubric_items.reasoning: findings — §37's promised refusal cannot see most of §35's cohort through normal export, and its two other claimed consumers do not receive the live graph evidence the proposed shared predicate needs.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §37 in `plan.html:243-245` has one source-integrity guard goal, with export, audit and lifecycle as its proposed surfaces.
